title: A US payer pays for the SAINT neuromodulation system
proposition: A US health plan or Medicare adopts a coverage policy or payment rate that pays for treatment with the SAINT neuromodulation system.

title: HIPAA enforcement action over the BetterHelp health-data disclosures
gate_reason: A HIPAA enforcement action over disclosure of user health data is a health-privacy legal outcome, not a decision about a psychiatric drug, device or treatment or about payment for and access to one.
proposition: HHS or the DOJ brings a HIPAA enforcement action against BetterHelp or Teladoc Health over the health-information disclosures described in the FTC complaint.

title: Psilocybin prescription volume reaches classic antidepressant prescription volume
proposition: Annual prescription volume of psilocybin drug products is at or above the annual prescription volume of classic antidepressants by the period end, per a named prescription-volume series.

title: A COMP360 (psilocybin) Phase 3 trial in treatment-resistant depression meets its primary endpoint
proposition: A Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (synthetic psilocybin) in treatment-resistant depression reports its prespecified primary endpoint met with statistical significance.

title: COMP360 (psilocybin) reports its first Phase 3 topline result
proposition: Compass Pathways reports the topline primary-endpoint result, in either direction, of the first Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (synthetic psilocybin).

title: An atai psychedelic programme reports a Phase 3 trial that meets its primary endpoint
proposition: A Phase 3 trial of a psychedelic therapeutic developed, owned or partnered by atai Life Sciences reports its prespecified primary endpoint met.

title: FDA authorizes a TMS device for psychosis
proposition: The FDA grants a marketing authorization for a transcranial magnetic stimulation device whose indications for use name a psychotic disorder or auditory hallucinations.
